name: Yukisaki Erika
source:
Hobbies: Doing yoga
Likes: When her works get complimented, seeing the credits in good games, high heels, hot springs
Dislikes: Having dinner with higher ups, paydays, shochu

[url=/c98085]Erena's[/url] older sister and the representative director of the up-and-coming game company "Innocent Ark Corporation". Erika has a very friendly personality and always tries to quickly become close with the people she's interested in. She is also quite mature and competent.

[Based on the [url=http://ainolinks.com/]official website[/url]]
